study: Prospectively frozen reasoning-enabled configuration recheck of the saved Qwen3-8B benchmark
selection: All 24 existing controlled families, homogeneous and heterogeneous merged direct prompts (48), and all 52 source prompts. No outcome-based selection. Controlled fragmented and changed-exposure conditions excluded from this compute-limited recheck. Two separate development prompts only verify the engine.
primary_endpoint: Answer within 0.5 percentage points; original strict JSON scorer. Source ledger exactness and deterministic weighted calculator retain original tolerances. Truncated completions are failures.
secondary_format_view: Remove only one enclosing complete JSON markdown fence; alias lots to rows only if rows absent and lots is a list. Do not repair numbers, units, content, or incomplete JSON. Never extract final answers from reasoning text.
analysis: Full sample comparison against saved original responses; homogeneous-minus-heterogeneous accuracy and 10000 paired-family bootstrap resamples. Source counts descriptive; funds are reused. Report format failures, truncation and request errors. One sample per request; no best-of-N. Report source results separately by merged/fragmented representation, and a complete census of numerical or ledger failures under the format-only view.
interpretation: Same-weights and same-system/user-text configuration stress test. The original json_object output constraint is retained. Thinking, sampling, seed, output budget and runtime context/batching differ, so improvement cannot be attributed to thinking alone. Inputs were previously observed, not a new blind holdout; a ceiling result does not prove equivalence.
calculator_scope: Externally calculate weighted exposures from model-emitted source ledger, without oracle field correction. This is a ledger-plus-calculator pipeline, not an autonomous interactive tool-use evaluation.
completion_policy: Run all 100 frozen evaluation requests; saved failures are never replaced. An interruption can resume only unsaved request IDs, logged as a new segment. Developer prompts are excluded.
setup_note: Before any development or evaluation inference, corrected engine preflight assertion: the official Qwen template leaves an open assistant turn in thinking mode, rather than prefilling <think>. The disabled template prefills a closed empty think block. Compare both templates; verify actual reasoning in development outputs. No outcome was available when this implementation correction was made.
engineering_probe: After two non-evaluation development responses, test whether reasoning and the original json_object constraint work together. One development final had correct numeric values but the wrong outer structure. No evaluation response has been generated. This probe cannot alter the 100 prompts or the fixed scoring criteria.
engineering_probe_result: Two prompts run once without JSON output constraint and once with the original json_object constraint (4 development responses, excluded from evaluation). Both configurations produced reasoning and completed without truncation. The unconstrained ledger final was an array with correct numeric values but wrong schema; the constrained final contained the requested rows and total_a_percent. Retain json_object for all 100 evaluation calls. This was decided before any evaluation call.
